gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund column: p5 'Transfers (to) from other funds' prints Other Governmental Fund (Rehab) (15,800), not in detail; added. (2) Different basis: the JSON statement transfers_out 36,820 is the p5 Total Governmental Funds net figure (36,820), and transfers_in is null, while detail records transfers gross per fund: out General (14,132) + (15,000) (p12 departments; General Fund column (29,132) on p5), Street (19,041) (p10), Rehab (15,800) = 63,973; in Sales Tax 27,153 (p11, already in detail as Transfers In). After the addition: 48,173 + 15,800 = 63,973; 63,973 - 27,153 (Sales Tax transfer in, netted in the Total column) = 36,820 = statement figure. The remaining 27,153 above the statement is netting only, not an error.
